> 第1章 穿越意外（第1页）
2030年3月1日晚，在地球华夏边境一个小镇上，姬云生正在和朋友通宵打着英雄联盟，他抽着烟笑着回复朋友的问题：“这个鬼天气也是离谱，大晚上打什么雷闪什么电啊！就是不下雨，不会有人渡劫吧！”当他说完这句话时，突然一阵剧烈的雷声响起，
一道闪电照亮天际，这把姬云生都吓一跳，突然刺眼的光芒闪烁，一道奇异的力量包裹着他，把他带到了苍玄大陆。正当他回过神来，眼睛睁开看了看周围环境，刚想要说什么，突然发现自己说话，就和婴儿一般咿咿呀呀！姬云生心里喃喃道：“卧槽，什么情况，
我怎么说不了话啊！”然后下意识伸出手看了看后，直接给他看呆了，因为他此时的双手如同婴儿一般，心里喃喃道：“卧槽，我这是穿越了？这哪个王八犊子干的好事！穿越就穿越了，系统呢？还有老子怎么成婴儿了？这不会是穿越出现意外了吧？
还有这是什么地方啊？荒郊野岭的，老子不会是刚穿越就要死了吧！”这时突然走过来一个，相貌平平的中年男子，把他抱了起来，查看一番，有些可怜的口语说道：“唉，这是哪家的小孩子啊？居然被扔在这里，也不知道这小家伙的亲生父母是何等狠心。
要不是我上山打猎，这小家伙要不了多久就成妖兽的食物了。算了算了，看这小家伙也刚出生不久，我就带他回去，和晓云当弟弟好好养着吧。”姬云生一听愣住了，刚想要说话，又发现自己说不了话，只能挣扎着，陈明看着姬云生的动静，
还以为姬云生不愿意，笑脸对着他说道：“小家伙，别害怕，我陈明虽然只是凡人，但我不是坏人。等回去村子后，我会好好照顾你的，等你长大后，要是想去找自己的亲生父母的话，也要等到时候长大后才能去。”姬云生一听顿时不挣扎了，只是静静的看着他，
心里喃喃道：“卧槽了，这穿越也是出现意外了，看这陈明应该不是坏人，就跟着他回去吧。”陈明看姬云生不挣扎后，顿时大笑起来，看着姬云生笑着问道：“小家伙，要不我给你取个名字？不然的话，以后我总不能一直叫你小家伙吧！”
姬云生一听顿时又摇头了，又一阵挣扎，陈明见状也是疑惑了，不敢置信的看着他笑着问道：“小家伙，你这是能听懂我说的话？”姬云生一听也不挣扎了，连忙点头，陈明见状也是吃惊了，笑着说道：“我的天，看来小家伙你应该是那些修仙大能的孩子，
不然刚出生哪里来的如此灵性。”姬云生一听顿时愣住了，心里喃喃道：“哎呦卧槽！这他喵的，还真穿越到修仙世界了。”陈明见状想了想，笑着说道：“小家伙，你看这样可好？我呢就不给你取名了，但是还是要取个小名，你看这可以吗？可以的话，点点头。”
姬云生一听点点头，陈明见状顿时一只手抱着他，一只手挠挠头，笑着说道：“小家伙，既然你同意了，那等回去村子，我让我的女儿给你取个小名。晓云的知识可是比我渊博多了，由她给你取名，我想应该能让你满意的。”姬云生一听顿时连忙点头，
陈明见状笑了笑说道：“你这小家伙，真是！”然后就不继续说了，抱着姬云生就下山去了，时间一点点过去，到了太阳要落山时！陈明抱着他终于到陈家村了，他站在村口笑着说道：“小家伙，这就是我在的村子了，名为陈家村，以后你就跟着陈叔我先在这里生活吧！”

The latest chapter of Eternal Lord of All Worlds_Chapter 1 Time Travel Accident Page 1_Eternal Lord of All Worlds A Stranger in the Mortal World_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 1 Time Travel Accident (Page 1)
On the evening of March 1, 2030, in a small town on the border of China on Earth, Ji Yunsheng was playing League of Legends with his friends all night long. He smoked a cigarette and replied to his friend's question with a smile: "The weather is outrageous. There will be thunder and lightning at night! If it doesn't rain, no one will survive the disaster!" When he finished saying this, a sudden burst of thunder sounded,
A bolt of lightning illuminated the sky, which startled Ji Yunsheng. Suddenly, a dazzling light flashed, and a strange power enveloped him, taking him to Cangxuan Continent. Just when he came back to his senses, he opened his eyes and looked at his surroundings. He was about to say something, but suddenly he found that he was babbling like a baby! Ji Yunsheng murmured in his heart: "Fuck, what's going on?
Why can't I speak? "Then he subconsciously stretched out his hand and looked at it. He was stunned because his hands were like a baby at this time. He murmured in his heart: "Damn it, have I traveled through time? What a good thing this bastard did! Time travel means time travel, what about the system? And why did I become a baby? Could this be a time-travel accident?
And what kind of place is this? It's in the wilderness, I'm not going to die just after crossing over, right? "At this time, a middle-aged man with a plain appearance suddenly came over, picked him up, checked him, and said pitifully: "Hey, whose child is this? To be thrown here, I don’t know how cruel this little guy’s biological parents are.
If I hadn't gone hunting in the mountains, this little guy would have become food for monsters in a short time. Forget it, seeing as this little guy was just born, I will take him back and raise him as a younger brother with Xiaoyun. "Ji Yunsheng was stunned when he heard this. Just when he wanted to speak, he found that he couldn't speak and could only struggle. Chen Ming looked at Ji Yunsheng's movements and said,
Thinking that Ji Yunsheng was unwilling, he said to him with a smile: "Little guy, don't be afraid. Although I, Chen Ming, are just a mortal, I am not a bad person. When I go back to the village, I will take good care of you. When you grow up, if you want to find your biological parents, you have to wait until you grow up." When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he stopped struggling and just looked at him quietly.
He murmured in his heart: "Damn it, there was an accident in this time travel. It seems that this Chen Ming is not a bad guy, so just follow him back." After seeing that Ji Yunsheng was not struggling, Chen Ming burst out laughing. He looked at Ji Yunsheng and asked with a smile: "Little guy, how about I give you a name? Otherwise, I can't always call you little guy in the future!"
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he immediately shook his head and struggled again. Chen Ming was also confused when he saw this. He looked at him in disbelief and asked with a smile: "Little guy, can you understand what I said?" Ji Yunsheng stopped struggling and nodded quickly. Chen Ming was also surprised when he saw this, and said with a smile: "My God, it seems that you are one of those children who can cultivate immortals, little guy.
Otherwise, how could he be so spiritual when he was born? "Ji Yunsheng was stunned when he heard this, and murmured in his heart: "Oh, shit! Damn it, he really traveled to the world of cultivating immortals. Chen Ming thought for a moment and said with a smile: "Little guy, do you think this is okay?" I won’t give you a name, but I still want to give you a nickname. Do you think this is okay? Nod if you can. "
Ji Yunsheng nodded when he heard this. When Chen Ming saw this, he immediately hugged him with one hand, scratched his head with the other hand, and said with a smile: "Little guy, since you agreed, when we go back to the village, I will ask my daughter to give you a nickname. Xiaoyun is much more knowledgeable than me. I think she should be able to name you, and I think it should satisfy you." Ji Yunsheng nodded quickly after hearing this,
Chen Ming smiled when he saw thisHe said: "You little guy, that's true!" Then he stopped talking, hugged Ji Yunsheng and went down the mountain. Time passed little by little, and the sun was about to set! Chen Ming hugged him and finally arrived at Chenjiacun. He stood at the entrance of the village and said with a smile: "Little guy, this is the village I am in. It is called Chenjiacun. From now on, you can live here with Uncle Chen and me!"
